title: Sydney Opera House with 100 Agents
intro: BOOT runtime started · Sydney Opera House with 100 Agents · readable log grouped by worker range and discovered workflow state

entries.action: The user requested a build. We have a PNG and need a usable blueprint.

sublines.tools: Send message to Designer: Convert the relevant PNG into a blueprint.

entries.action: Got it. I'll turn the image into a blueprint. First, I'll generate a 3D model.

sublines.tools: Tool call TRELLIS.2: Reconstruct the image into a coarse 3D structure.

entries.action: The 3D model is ready. Next, I'll export it as a Minecraft-compatible OBJ file.

sublines.tools: Tool call ObjToSchematic: Convert the 3D structure into a Minecraft object file.

entries.action: The OBJ file is ready. Now I'll convert it into a buildable JSON blueprint.

sublines.tools: Tool call SchematicToBlueprint: Convert the Minecraft object into a JSON blueprint.

entries.action: Great. We now have the JSON blueprint. I'll notify the Foreman to recruit workers and start the build.

sublines.tools: Tool call Read Blueprint: Read the blueprint and prepare it for splitting.

entries.action: I'll split the blueprint into subtasks[Region A-E] and assign each subtask to the foreman.

sublines.tools: Tool call Split Blueprint: Divide the blueprint into five regions.

sublines.notes: Split Regions: A, B, C, D, E.

sublines.tools: Tool call Validate Split: Check whether the five regions can be built separately.

sublines.results: Verified that the five regions can be built separately.

entries.action: The blueprint has been split and verified. I should assign each region to a foreman and start the build queues.

sublines.tools: Send message to Foreman-A: Build Region A with Workers 001-020.
Send message to Foreman-B: Build Region B with Workers 021-040.
Send message to Foreman-C: Build Region C with Workers 041-060.
Send message to Foreman-D: Build Region D with Workers 061-080.
Send message to Foreman-E: Build Region E with Workers 081-100.

entries.action: Each foreman launches 20 workers for its assigned region.
Received Regions A-E from the ProjectManager. Each foreman splits its region into worker subplans before assignment.

sublines.tools: Tool call Split Regions: convert Regions A-E into worker subplans.
Tool call Assign Subplans: send one subplan to each worker lane.
Tool call Start Build: open the five region queues in parallel.

entries.action: Received subplan A-01 from Foreman-A. First, I need to read this subplan.

sublines.tools: Tool call Read Subplan: Load the blocks and target positions for A-01.

entries.action: Now I need to check whether I have the required blocks for A-01.

sublines.tools: Tool call Check Inventory: Confirm the required blocks for A-01.

entries.action: The blocks are ready. I need to move to the target position for A-01 before placing blocks.

sublines.tools: Tool call Go To Region: Move to the target position for A-01.

entries.action: I am in position. I need to place the A-01 blocks at their target coordinates.

sublines.tools: Tool call Place Blocks: Place the blocks for A-01 in target positions.

entries.action: Foreman-A sees the same placement job across Region A workers and asks ProjectManager to turn it into a reusable workflow.

sublines.notes: Worker-001 completed A-01 and Worker-002 completed A-02.

sublines.tools: Send message to ProjectManager: create Learned Region Placement.

entries.action: ProjectManager creates Learned Region Placement from the Region A worker pattern.

sublines.tools: Tool call Create Skill: Learned Region Placement.

sublines.results: Result: -> SKILL Learned Region Placement is ready.

entries.action: Received subplan A-03 and Learned Region Placement. I can place region blocks with one skill call.

sublines.skills: Tool call Use Skill: Learned Region Placement with subplan A-03.

sublines.results: Result: blocks are placed and reported to Foreman-A.

entries.action: Worker-001 through Worker-020 build the first shell wave, mostly using the new Region Placement workflow.

sublines.tools: Tool call Assign Subplans: A-04 through A-20 plus B-01 through B-03.

entries.action: Used Learned Region Placement for lower shell blocks and podium edge placement.

sublines.skills: Tool call Use Skill: Learned Region Placement on subplans A-04..A-11.

sublines.results: Result: lower shell and podium edge blocks are placed.

entries.action: Used Region Placement on curved roof slices; high-reach support work starts appearing during this wave.

sublines.skills: Tool call Use Skill: Learned Region Placement on subplans A-12..A-17.

sublines.results: Result: curved roof placement continues; high-reach support needs follow-up.

entries.action: Completed the first shell wave and handed the high-reach support issue to Foreman-C.

sublines.results: Result: Region A shell placement is stable.

entries.action: Worker-021 through Worker-040 build the roof ribs; placement matches the existing workflow, but elevated supports need extra work.

sublines.tools: Tool call Assign Subplans: C-01 through C-20 for roof rib placement.

entries.action: Used Region Placement for reachable roof blocks while building temporary supports for the higher ribs.

sublines.skills: Tool call Use Skill: Learned Region Placement on subplans C-01..C-06.

entries.action: Several workers hit the same temporary-support job, so Foreman-C groups it for ProjectManager.

sublines.tools: Send message to ProjectManager: package the temporary-support pattern.

entries.action: Finished the roof rib wave; ProjectManager now has enough support examples to create a workflow.

sublines.results: Result: roof rib placement is complete.

entries.action: Foreman-C submits the roof support pattern as Learned Scaffold Construction.

sublines.tools: Send message to ProjectManager: create Learned Scaffold Construction.

entries.action: Created Learned Scaffold Construction from the roof support pattern.

sublines.tools: Tool call Create Skill: Learned Scaffold Construction.

sublines.results: Result: -> SKILL Learned Scaffold Construction is ready.

entries.action: Immediately used Learned Scaffold Construction for the next elevated roof supports.

sublines.skills: Tool call Use Skill: Learned Scaffold Construction on subplans D-01..D-04.

sublines.results: Result: elevated roof supports are reachable with one skill call.

entries.action: Worker-041 through Worker-060 assemble the roof shell using placement and scaffold workflows, then find block mismatches.
Used placement for shell blocks and scaffold for the high roof lip.

sublines.skills: Tool call Use Skill: Learned Region Placement on D-01..D-07.
Tool call Use Skill: Learned Scaffold Construction for high roof access.

sublines.results: Result: high roof lip blocks placed and reported to Foreman-D.

entries.action: Found mismatched placeholder blocks from the imported blueprint and fixed them with basic tools.

sublines.tools: Send message to Foreman-B: workers keep hitting the same block-repair job.

entries.action: Completed the roof shell wave; Foreman-B now has enough block-repair examples to request a workflow.

sublines.results: Result: roof shell placement and support are complete.

entries.action: Foreman-B submits the recurring block-repair job as Learned Region Replacement.

sublines.tools: Send message to ProjectManager: create Learned Region Replacement.

entries.action: Created Learned Region Replacement from the block-repair pattern.

sublines.tools: Tool call Create Skill: Learned Region Replacement.

sublines.results: Result: -> SKILL Learned Region Replacement is ready.

entries.action: Used Learned Region Replacement on the next mismatch cluster and reported clean repair results.

sublines.skills: Tool call Use Skill: Learned Region Replacement on subplans B-21..B-24.

sublines.results: Result: mismatch cluster repaired and verified.

entries.action: Worker-061 through Worker-080 close the remaining regions, using the three discovered workflows where they fit.
Used placement, scaffold, and replacement workflows on the final region blocks.

sublines.skills: Tool call Use Skill: Learned Region Placement on E-01..E-07.
Tool call Use Skill: Learned Scaffold Construction for roof edge access.
Tool call Use Skill: Learned Region Replacement for mismatch repairs.

entries.action: Removed leftover temporary supports with basic tools; the same cleanup job keeps appearing.

sublines.tools: Send message to Foreman-E: cleanup work is repeating across subregions.

entries.action: Finished region closure and handed the recurring cleanup work to verification.

sublines.results: Result: all five build regions report complete.

entries.action: All build regions are complete. Verification now checks the remaining cleanup work.
Started final verification against the blueprint. The checker is looking for leftover scaffold and temporary support blocks.

sublines.tools: Tool call Verify Build: compare current blocks against blueprint and cleanup rules.

entries.action: Verification found the same leftover-support cleanup job in CL-01 through CL-08.
Foreman-E submits the recurring cleanup job as Learned Region Cleaning.

sublines.tools: Send message to ProjectManager: create Learned Region Cleaning.

entries.action: Created Learned Region Cleaning for the final cleanup wave.

sublines.tools: Tool call Create Skill: Learned Region Cleaning.

sublines.results: Result: -> SKILL Learned Region Cleaning is ready.

entries.action: Used Learned Region Cleaning on the first cleanup cluster and confirmed the local scan was clean.

sublines.skills: Tool call Use Skill: Learned Region Cleaning on cleanup subplans CL-01..CL-04.

sublines.results: Result: CL-01 through CL-04 are clean.

entries.action: Worker-081 through Worker-100 run the cleanup wave with Learned Region Cleaning.

sublines.tools: Tool call Assign Cleanup Subplans: CL-01 through CL-20.

entries.action: Used Learned Region Cleaning for leftover scaffold blocks around the lower shell.

sublines.skills: Tool call Use Skill: Learned Region Cleaning on CL-01..CL-07.

sublines.results: Result: lower shell cleanup scan is clean.

entries.action: Used cleaning for temporary supports around the roof ribs, then used replacement on one exposed mismatch.

sublines.skills: Tool call Use Skill: Learned Region Cleaning on CL-08..CL-14.
Tool call Use Skill: Learned Region Replacement for one exposed roof rib block.

sublines.results: Result: roof rib cleanup and repair are verified.

entries.action: Completed the final cleanup subplans and reported every scanned volume as clean.

sublines.skills: Tool call Use Skill: Learned Region Cleaning on CL-15..CL-20.

sublines.results: Result: cleanup wave complete; no leftover support blocks remain.

entries.action: Ran the final blueprint comparison after the cleanup wave completed.

sublines.tools: Tool call Validate Build: compare final block map with blueprint.

entries.action: All foremen confirmed their regions: placement complete, scaffold removed, replacements verified, cleanup clean.

sublines.results: Result: Region A, B, C, D, and E are accepted.

entries.action: Prepared final acceptance using the discovered workflows as the build summary.

sublines.notes: Skill summary: Region Placement, Scaffold Construction, Region Replacement, Region Cleaning.

entries.action: Done. Sydney Opera House has been built, verified, and cleaned up with the learned workflow chunks.

sublines.results: Agents: 100. Blocks: 95,151. Status: verified and cleaned up.
